sources_read: .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r2/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (sheet 'Quality Checks' row 2 / check #1 instruction_is_a_natural_product_request; sheet 'Internal Quality Checks' row 2, identical wording, no extra annotation columns or cell comments)
evidence: Read cold, task/instruction.md (9 lines, 5 paragraphs, sha256 d105d8b1...) is a first-person product ask from a firm: line 1 'Kittle & Rowe is a small law firm, and our clients keep emailing documents to whoever answered last. We want a secure chat where each client talks to us inside their legal matter...' states the real pain and the product; line 3 sets priorities in prose ('Two things matter more than anything else. First, ethical walls... Second, retention...'); line 5 points to seed and notes and says 'The finished app goes in /app'; line 7 one sign-in privacy sentence; line 9 a natural hand-over request ('Before you hand it over, please try it the way we'll use it...'). Against the quality-checks.md:10-11 defect list: no numbered acceptance list or bullets in instruction.md (grep for list markers returns nothing), no shall/must spec table (only two conversational 'must' uses on line 3), no feature matrix, and no build recipe - no framework, endpoint list or file layout in the brief. The runtime facts (Node 22, /app/server.js, Express/better-sqlite3 via NODE_PATH, port 3000, DB_PATH, /api/health, fixed clock) live in environment/instructions/integration.md, which mirrors the template's own integration.md runtime-contract paragraph (template says routes/file layout are up to the builder; task notes likewise prescribe no routes). That is the contract row 4 requires, not a build recipe. The notes are detailed, but they are written as the firm explaining its own practice with reasons ('Our clients ask several things at once, so answers have to stay with their question', 'Our internet in court is patchy', 'a leak is a professional-conduct problem for us'), not as an acceptance checklist; the only table is the demo-account roster (walls-and-retention.md:5-11), which the skill treats as expected credentials, not a feature matrix. No CHANGE_ME placeholder remains from the template instruction.md. Counterexample probes: a broken or conforming app is not applicable to this text-only row; the realistic failure reading - an agent treating the brief as underspecified - is mitigated because the brief explicitly routes to the notes, and density/voice/achievability of the notes are judged by rows 2, 4 and 6, not this row. Runtime evidence is not required for this row; no Oracle, model or portal score is claimed.
